title: Recover a towel from a stopped washing machine
instruction: Take the towel out of the stopped washer.
setup: Development gate: original-size Bosch WGG24402IL/01 cabinet and door on the documented 390mm pedestal beside the unmodified station. This isolated diagnostic starts with a free door; lock, water and towel are not yet implemented.
scoring: Development only: always 0. No full repair or validation claimed.
fidelity: Manufacturer envelope and source-scaled door geometry. Native rigid contacts and original hinge; 3.2kg door mass, hinge resistance and secondary dimensions are estimates. This initial access diagnostic omits the lock, drainage and towel and cannot score.
scores: Dream-1: not run; demo: not validated
